method: Measured original 2880x1200 frame pixels. Body long-axis manually confirmed on straight short-edge sections. No new downloaded references or Blender runs.

corner_fit.qualification: The y/x ratio 1.033 is not a calibrated pose transform; this may combine noncircular authored curvature and slight perspective. Fit demonstrates current 10.7mm circular corner is substantially rounder than the source. Do not claim precise OEM circular radius.
